messages:
taylor: FYI VeroOne wants to run 4 parallel POCs and asks if we can stack credits and roll everything into one enterprise commit if they convert within 90 days. They also asked that leftover credits be assignable between business units.
samir: Quick rules: stacking ok only when POCs map to the same BILLING_ENTITY. Transfers between BUs ok only if billed under same billing account and explicitly mapped in SOW.
ema: Deal Desk: we can offer consolidation but recommend capping active POCs to 3 by default for this account. Allow 4 only with VP approval and explicit transfer rules. 90d conversion window is acceptable if Legal signs off on transferability.
deal-desk-bot: Reminder - open a /deal-request and attach SOW + CSV. Use template: https://confluence.redwood/poc-commit-matrix (internal).
revops: RevOps needs CSV with columns: BILLING_ENTITY,POC_TAG,START_TS,END_TS,CREDIT_CAP,TRANSFERABLE_FLAG,CONSOLIDATE_COMMIT_ID,RATECARD_VERSION. Attach to /deal-request.
infra: Ops note: strongly prefer metered+credited so we retain telemetry. If they want "no metering" we can't validate sizing; also shared endpoints may reduce combined cost due to KV cache. Call that out in the quote.
taylor: Customer asks for no metering during POC and reserved credits for 90d. Is "no metering" doable? :grimacing:
samir: Not recommended. We'll meter and apply credits after the window. That keeps audit trail and capacity signals.
ema: Draft SOW snippet (for deal-request):
```
RATECARD=v3.2
BILLING_ENTITY=VeroOne-Parent
POC_TAGS=VERO-POC-A,VERO-POC-B,VERO-POC-C,VERO-POC-D
POC_WINDOW=2026-09-01 to 2026-09-30
POC_CREDIT=100% metered usage credited up to $25,000 per POC
CONVERSION_WINDOW=90d
CREDIT_EXPIRATION=90d
STACKING_LIMIT=3 active POCs per BILLING_ENTITY (VP approval required for 4)
TRANSFER_RULES=Transferable within BILLING_ENTITY up to 50% of pooled credits with Deal Desk approval
RATE_SKU_REFERENCES=redwood.gen.gn-xl:v3.2;redwood.quant.small:v3.2
DISCLOSURE=Shared infra or endpoint reuse may result in lower combined token burn than isolated estimates
```
legal-bot: Legal: lock RATECARD version in SOW; credits are timeboxed and applied to future invoices only; no cash refunds for committed fees; require usage validation and audit rights before applying credits; transfers limited to accounts under same legal entity.
taylor: I'll confirm billing_entity with the customer and attach CSV + model usage by EOD, then open /deal-request and route to Legal. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
